name: Philip Dames
title: Associate Professor; Temple Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Lab Director
fitReason: Strong safe robot-learning and multi-robot match, with actual learned navigation in busy university hallways and an explicit institutional graduate-intern category.

physicalEvidence.summary: SCOPE’s June 2025 primary revision executes DRL-VO navigation with learned SO-SCOPE occupancy prediction and YOLOv3 on a physical TurtleBot2 with Jetson Xavier, Hokuyo LiDAR and ZED camera, avoiding moving pedestrians in Temple hallways. The physical learned stack traveled 86.41 m; its crowd-density success tables are Gazebo, and SCAND Jackal/Spot data are separate offline evaluation. Lab lists coauthor Zhanteng Xie as its 2024 PhD alumnus. DELIVER additionally executes LLaMA3-parsed relay waypoints on three TurtleBot3s in a 1.7 m-square obstacle-free testbed; package/LED coordination should not be upgraded to dexterous object handover.

shortVisit.summary: Current lab and publications are active through 2026, but no lab-level invitation for external-master’s short visits was verified. Temple’s explicit graduate Student Intern mechanism is an institutional pathway, not a Dames lab offer.

scoreReasons.fit: Deep prediction/control and language-guided robot coordination with physical deployment.
scoreReasons.physical: Specific learned TurtleBot2 navigation at current host; directed-lab publication and former-advisee linkage.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: University eligibility alone does not prove a lab short-visit opportunity.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current lab 2026 publications and 2025 full primary hardware study.
